I work on carbon markets and greenhouse-gas measurement, reporting and verification. These notes ask what those instruments can do for other problems, starting with delegating authority to AI agents.

Each note is dated and versioned. A new version replaces the old one at the same address and says what changed. The [tests](cases/index.qmd) page describes the small experiments the notes draw on. To get new notes and versions by email, subscribe to [Ember Notes](https://buttondown.email/Willember).
